### Q9IK90 — Matrix protein
- Organism: Nipah virus
- Reviewed: True
- Source: local_uniprot_swissprot_xml

- function: Plays a crucial role in virion assembly and budding. Forms a shell at the inner face of the plasma membrane (PubMed:17005661, PubMed:17204159, PubMed:19000317).
